detail.longDescription: Three failure patterns our Tri-Cameral Red-Team Auditor keeps catching in production SaaS & AI stacks: 1. Next.js: edge middleware passes, yet Server Actions trust raw orgId and serialize full DB entities across RSC. 2. Stripe: webhook handlers lack atomic event.id claims and return 400 on foreign metadata, causing retry storms. 3. MCP Agents: fetch_url follows 302 redirects into RFC1918/metadata IPs. Full $29 teardown reports + free 5s URL scan in reply. # AppSec # DevOps # AIAgents
